layers.authority: Instituto Chico Mendes de Conservação da Biodiversidade (ICMBio)
layers.process: Abrolhos Marine National Park (Parque Nacional Marinho dos Abrolhos), off southern Bahia: visits happen through tour companies authorised by ICMBio, which follow set rules for visitor safety and protection of the reef. Book with an authorised operator.

layers.authority: Instituto Chico Mendes de Conservação da Biodiversidade (ICMBio)
layers.process: Filming or photography for commercial use in a federal conservation unit such as Abrolhos needs a special image-capture authorisation from ICMBio, requested through its service page.

public_holidays: 2027-07-02 (Friday): Dois de Julho (Independência da Bahia), state holiday set by the state constitution (art. 6, par. 3)
culture-cycles.note: The state sets other optional days (pontos facultativos, such as Carnival) by a yearly decree for its own offices; the 2027 decree is not yet published. Municipal holidays are not covered here.

laws.rule: Bahia state Lei 12.959/2014 allows alcohol to be sold and drunk at stadiums and sports arenas under conditions: the seller needs a municipal permit plus health, fire and police reports; sales in bars and food stalls, boxes and VIP areas start 2 hours before the match; drinks are served only in plastic cups of up to 500 ml; no sales to anyone under 18. Federal sports law (Lei 10.671/2003, art. 28) is kept in view.
laws.penalty_signal: seller fines of 3,000 to 30,000 UFIR, suspension of 30 to 360 days, or a ban on alcohol sales at the venue
laws.heading: Lei 12.959/2014
